Origin and meaning

With Germanic origins, Linda is usually read as “beautiful, soft”.

About the name Linda

A Spanish word for 'beautiful' that was the US number one in the 1940s.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Linda as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “beautiful, soft”, is part of the appeal.
